articles.title: PREVIEW: Maine to meet #11 Kentucky, Tulane at Daytona Beach Classic
articles.summary: ORONO, Maine -- Following a four-game homestand, the University of Maine women's basketball team will compete at the 2026 Daytona Beach Classic on Nov. 27 and 28. The Black Bears will open play on Friday at 4:45 p.m. against No. 11 Kentucky before meeting Tulane on Saturday at 11 a.m.

articles.title: Men's Swim & Dive places fourth at Harold Anderson Invitational
articles.summary: KINGSTON, R.I. -- Henry Schattle's third-place finish in the 1,650-yard freestyle led the Maine men's swimming team on the final day of the Harold Anderson Invitational on Sunday. Schattle finished in 16:19.42 as the Black Bears closed the four-day meet in fourth place with 500 points.

articles.title: Volpe wins 200-yard breaststroke to close out Harold Anderson Invitational
articles.summary: KINGSTON, R.I. -- Gabi Volpe won the 200-yard breaststroke to lead the Maine women's swimming team on the final day of the Harold Anderson Invitational on Sunday. Volpe touched in 2:18.29, edging Rhode Island's Logan Norrid by six hundredths of a second for the title.

articles.title: Sain's 29-point effort lifts Maine over VCU in overtime, 85-80

articles.summary: ORONO, Maine -- University of Maine women's basketball head coach has announced the signing of Hannah Fraser. Fraser, a 6-2 forward, will be eligible to join the Black Bears in the fall of 2027.
